name: AutoKaggle
abstract: AutoKaggle evaluates autonomous data-science work end to end: a phase-based multi-agent pipeline plans, writes, debugs, and validates complete Kaggle solutions — background understanding through feature engineering to submission. Results on this page will be populated at the next TokenWave data refresh.
contributions: Treats a Kaggle competition as one deliverable pipeline, not isolated code snippets.
A phase-based workflow with cooperating agents (reading, planning, coding, reviewing, summarizing) plus iterative debugging and unit tests.
Includes a machine-learning tools library so agents assemble reliable pipelines instead of improvising every step.
method: Each competition run proceeds through fixed phases with validation gates between them.
Generated code is unit-tested and debugged in place before the pipeline advances.
Runs are scored on completion of a valid submission and on solution quality across competitions.

metrics.name: Completion rate
metrics.note: Share of competition runs that end in a valid, reproducible submission.

at_a_glance.setting: Multi-phase agent runs on Kaggle tasks
